en-US.description:
Friends, our country has many high mountains in the east.
Over those mountains, the beautiful East Sea appears.
Today's story is about a scholar who set out to see the sea by crossing the high mountains in the east.
In the old days, there were no cars or trains, so people had to travel by horse or on foot.
Will the scholar who embarked on this difficult journey ever reach the sea?
2025 has been a year of hardship and challenges,
but Gamho will cheer on all of you who have had wonderful journeys and hope you have a warm winter.
(If you're curious about Gamho's story, visit Gamhodogam on Instagram at @gamhodogam!)

snippet.description:
친구들, 장칼국수라고 들어본 적 있나요?
강원도 강릉에서는 예전부터 겨울이 되면
집집마다 뜨끈한 장칼국수를 자주 끓여 먹었대요.

바닷바람이 차가운 강릉은
몸을 따뜻하게 해주는 뜨거운 음식이 꼭 필요했어요.
그래서 집에서 직접 담근 간장과 고추장을 풀어
얼큰하고 구수한 국물을 만들고,
밀가루 반죽을 얇게 밀어 칼칼하고 쫄깃한 국수를 넣어 먹었지요.

배도 든든해지고, 마음도 따뜻해지는 한 그릇!
그래서 온 가족이 함께 둘러앉아
장칼국수를 먹으며 겨울을 났답니다.

그럼 오늘은
우리도 마음이 따뜻해지는
장칼국수 이야기 속으로
함께 들어가 볼까요?

en-US.title: [Whispering Travel Stories] Everyone, Noodle Feast! / Mom's Doll Stories
en-US.description:
Friends, have you ever heard of Jangkalguksu?
In Gangneung, Gangwon Province, every winter,
every household would often boil and eat a bowl of hot Jangkalguksu.

Gangneung, with its cold sea breeze,
needed a hot dish to warm the body.

So, they made a spicy and savory soup by mixing homemade soy sauce and red pepper paste,
then rolled out the wheat dough thinly and served it with chewy noodles.

A bowl that fills both the stomach and the heart!

So, the whole family would gather around and eat Jangkalguksu to survive the winter.

So, today,
let's dive into the heartwarming story of Jangkalguksu.

(If you're curious about Gamho's story, visit Gamhodogam on Instagram @gamhodogam!)

친구들, 장칼국수라고 들어본 적 있나요?
강원도 강릉에서는 예전부터 겨울이 되면
집집마다 뜨끈한 장칼국수를 자주 끓여 먹었대요.

바닷바람이 차가운 강릉은
몸을 따뜻하게 해주는 뜨거운 음식이 꼭 필요했어요.
그래서 집에서 직접 담근 간장과 고추장을 풀어
얼큰하고 구수한 국물을 만들고,
밀가루 반죽을 얇게 밀어 칼칼하고 쫄깃한 국수를 넣어 먹었지요.

배도 든든해지고, 마음도 따뜻해지는 한 그릇!
그래서 온 가족이 함께 둘러앉아
장칼국수를 먹으며 겨울을 났답니다.

그럼 오늘은
우리도 마음이 따뜻해지는
장칼국수 이야기 속으로
함께 들어가 볼까요?

en-US.description:
Friends, have you ever heard of Jangkalguksu?
In Gangneung, Gangwon Province, every winter,
every household would often boil and eat a bowl of hot Jangkalguksu.

Gangneung, with its cold sea breeze,
needed a hot dish to warm the body.

So, they made a spicy and savory soup by mixing homemade soy sauce and red pepper paste,
then rolled out the wheat dough thinly and served it with chewy noodles.

A bowl that fills both the stomach and the heart!

So, the whole family would gather around and eat Jangkalguksu to survive the winter.

So, today,
let's dive into the heartwarming story of Jangkalguksu.
